name: 9L discovery provenance binding for 9M
purpose: Preserve and validate explicit provenance for consumed 9L discoveries without constructing hypotheses from findings.
changes: HypothesisRecord.evidence is validated as immutable non-empty provenance tokens.
Added optional strict discovery-provenance gate to OosValidationEngine.run.
Legacy hypothesis identity remains byte-stable when no evidence token is supplied.
strict_gate: optional; disabled for historical fixtures, available for frozen preregistered execution
notes: This phase does not invent, select, or promote a hypothesis.
A human/research-layer preregistration still owns the hypothesis selection boundary.
Missing or mismatched provenance fails closed when strict mode is requested.
